text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora
brilliantly claims victory in the Oaks--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooah—!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Pandoooraaa!!
Congraaaats!!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Pan-chaaaan!!
*sob* You were the absolute best, *sniff*!!
choice_data_list: I was watching — you did great!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...!
Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Kuu-senpai—!
Where, where, where, where's the camera?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Kuu-chan-senpai!
Did you see that!? I did it!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora...!!
I saw you, huge congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, that really cheered me up a ton.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, right. Um,
'Great work out there.
Keep doing your best. I'll always be cheering for you!'"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...――
'I'll keep doing my best too!'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's Yushun Himba
came to a close with a fantastic result!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, get home safe too, Mom and Dad♡
Bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ...I really did my parents proud~.
Plus, Ku-chan-senpai sent me
such a sweet LANE message.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I won properly.
...I want to do my best in the Shuka Sho too~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright, gotta send Trainer a LANE.
"Where u at?"â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... Kawakami-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
You gave me so much courage today!
Thank you, and great job out there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Great job! Wonderful work, Kawakami-chan!
You did your absolute best! You were splendid!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed! That is quite right!
As a princess, one must keep their head held high and press ever forward!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it just wasn't our "moment of victory."
However, without fail, one day—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna turn this story into the world's most wonderful happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Oooooh!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa... Even though I was the one who won,
Kawakami-senpai is totally stealing the spotlight...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Actually—

text_block_list.name: Someone's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Even if you lost, your race was the best in the world!
You really gave it everything!

text_block_list.name: Someone's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I loved seeing you never give up until the very end!
I'll be cheering for you in your next race too☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? Come to think of it... I'm the one who won.
It should be a big deal, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (The view right now... ain't this totally different from my dream?)

text_block_list.name: Fans in Dream
text_block_list.text:
Pandora! Pandora!
Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (—A sparkling dream I absolutely want to make come true in the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (A precious dream... that I truly want to make come true before it all ends—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...If I hurry now... will I really make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Ah, crap,"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: My head is spinning, I hate it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(It's Trainer.
"I'm at the east gate." ..."K, omw!")

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nnh, nnnggggh...!!
Aaaargh, I don't get it!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—Well,
if I try my best, it'll work out somehow!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (That's how it's always been... up until now!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So・De・li・cious♡
choice_data_list: You really did great out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's hard work this time
properly paid off with a 1st place victory!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, thanks for the hard work, Trainer♡
Well, we got 1st place, so total success this time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then...
Next up is the Shuka Sho, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho—the final leg of the Triple Tiara.
A GⅠ race held in Kyoto during autumn, gathering the fiercest contenders.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. Trainer. Remember the other day,
when I said I wanted to win a bunch of GⅠs
super fast?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna win the Shuka Sho too.
Or rather, I wanna raise the curtain on the legend of Pandora."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I don't just want to win...
It's time to bring out the biggest cheer in history!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a lofty ideal. But, considering
her feelings of wanting to do it "before it ends,"
I should approach this with just as much dedication.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's give it our all with that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, I can do this, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mm! Mfufuâ¡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The final leg of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho.
Chasing after that glorious dream, I want to dash all the way through!”
